prior_importants.description: Nothing limits the length of a conductor question when it is asked, but its answer must fit `tellConductor`'s 800-character limit. A question of about 760+ characters can never be answered with `pup answer conductor`, and it stays at the top of the needs-you inbox until the conductor restarts.
QuestionRefusedError is declared inline in a service file instead of session-lifecycle.errors.ts.

findings.description: The new digit keys answer whichever session sits at the cursor's index. The new sortRank moves rows exactly when a question is asked or answered, so a refresh between reading and pressing can send one session's option to a different worker, with no confirm step.

pup ui's 1-9 keys pass the scrubbed display id (sanitizeReason(row.id)) and never check isMintedId. A planted row 't-abc ' shows its own question but sends an operator-attributed answer, of t-abc's own option n, to the real t-abc, whose question the operator never saw. The inbox's needOf already swaps in UNMINTED_ID for such rows. The older keys (s, k, m, u) share the scrubbed-id pattern, so refusing `!asking.isMintedId` in answerOption, and ideally in onSession, closes it.

The markConductorQuestion JSDoc says the question leads the inbox "until `pup answer conductor` closes it", but openQuestion and ADR 0093 also end it at the conductor's next start (conductor_start). It should say "until `pup answer conductor` or the conductor's next start closes it".
The boolean `marks` in dashboardQuestion has no is/has/should/can prefix, which general.md §Type safety requires for boolean names; rename it to, e.g., `isRecommendedInRange`.
The boolean `refused` in questionOrRefuse has no is/has/should/can prefix, which general.md §Type safety requires for boolean names; rename it to, e.g., `isRefusal`.

The prior important on QuestionRefusedError placement is carried forward as unresolved.

Downgraded the security finding on the digit key's scrubbed id (use-controls.hook.ts:246) from important to nit after validation confirmed it. The validator showed the scrubbed-id pattern predates the PR on the s/k/m/u keys, which do more harm on the same planted row, and that the digit key delivers only the target's own option text.
